In this section, we review matrices that transform the components of a vector
under rotation of the coordinate system. The transformation of 2D vector
components by coordinate rotation is first discussed. This result is extended to
consider the transformation of 3D vector components by rotations about all three
coordinate axes.

As an abbreviation for “Matrix Laboratory,” MATLAB is the software of choice
when handling large arrays for numerical computation. Examples of numeric and
symbolic operations on vectors and matrices in MATLAB are shown below.
Key MATLAB commands: conj, cross, det, dot, inv, kron, min, rand, simple, sym ,
